items.title: EIP-8141：把 MAX_VERIFY_GAS 定义为共享内存池下限
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）。理由是验证 frame 交易的实际成本随客户端、签名和配对库、存储后端、部分无状态节点而相差数倍，硬编码单节点上限形状不对。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: define MAX_VERIFY_GAS as a shared mempool floor
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil). The rationale is that the real cost of validating a frame transaction differs several-fold across clients, signature and pairing libraries, storage backends and partially stateless nodes, so a hardcoded per-node maximum is the wrong shape.

summary_en: Vitalik recommended reading about the last few months of progress on frame transactions (EIP-8141) and the updated EIP, saying a lot of important progress had been happening quietly; Derek Chiang said the authors recently achieved a design breakthrough, realizing things they thought had to go into the transaction envelope did not. The same day, a PR proposed defining `MAX_VERIFY_GAS` as a shared mempool floor rather than a per-node ceiling.
